analysis.title: The Final Countdown
key_insights: BTIG stays cautious into what it calls the seasonal apex of catalysts: the FOMC decision on Oct 28, several mega-cap earnings reports over the next two days, the U.S. mid-term elections next week, and continued hopes of a Middle East 'deal'.
The FOMC meeting is described as one of the least anticipated in some time, with 9% odds of a hike. BTIG says it has no edge in predicting the news and focuses on the 'reaction to the reaction'.

BTIG believes consensus sees the upcoming catalysts as 'clearing events' with smooth sailing into year-end. That is what happens on average, but BTIG says this year has not been average. With the SPX about 1% below an all-time high, it does not see anything in the next week as a clearing event.
Hedge fund positioning may be lighter than in recent months, but put/call ratios still suggest complacency.

Only one of the eleven S&P 500 sectors (communication services) has an RSI below 49. On March 31 only three sectors had an RSI above 50. Sectors that were hit have mostly bounced back, so there is little left to 'clear'.
Put/call ratios surged to roughly multi-year highs in March and July. They are off the lows now but far from panic despite the upcoming catalysts.

The 2000 SOX analog BTIG has been following diverged briefly but appears back on track. It implies a few more days of rally, then a sharp decline into November. BTIG calls this probably the least consensus view right now.

SOXX found buyers at its 200 DMA, as BTIG expected, but BTIG has little confidence the 200 DMA holds. If the analog keeps tracking, it expects SOXX to fail and turn lower in the 550-570 range, with a likely test of the 20/50 DMA convergence at 516-532 first.
SOXX printed a 10-count on Bloomberg Candle Sessions at the lows last week and is now on a 3-count on the upside. BTIG expects upside exhaustion in the next 4-7 days.
Two hyperscaler EPS reports so far have not worked as clearing events. META fell on the report and fell more afterward. SPCX rose on the report and then fell.
SK Hynix reacted positively after a -33% drawdown into the print, which BTIG treats as a short-term clearing event. It suspects SKHY can rally back toward $180 before failing again.

tension_points.bull_case: Consensus sees the FOMC, mega-cap earnings and the elections as clearing events, followed by smooth sailing into year-end, which is the average seasonal outcome.
tension_points.bear_case: This year has not been average. Put/call ratios show complacency and the SPX is about 1% below its all-time high. Few sectors were washed out, so there is little to clear.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A positive 'reaction to the reaction' in the mega-cap earnings, such as a gain that holds after the initial move.

theme_stances.key_argument: Positioning is not washed out and put/call ratios show complacency, so the upcoming catalysts are unlikely to clear risk.
